chapterTitle: Chapter 18 Ethers and Epoxides; Thiols and Sulfides
title: Problem 18-2

pages.text: PROBLEM 18-2 Why do you suppose only symmetrical ethers are prepared by the sulfuric-acid-catalyzed dehydration procedure? What product(s) would you expect if ethanol and 1-propanol were allowed to react together? In what ratio would the products be formed if the two alcohols were of equal reactivity?
